verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents issuing and distributing physical cards, nominated or innominate, with horizontal or vertical designs. Its guides cover a card design and production process, batch issuance of innominate cards stored at its logistics partner, and shipment tracking to the delivery address, so Pomelo handles manufacturing and logistics itself. The evidence only shows these as guide-level claims, not detailed API mechanics. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for ordering physical cards and submitting custom art, documented shipping-method options, API-level tracking detail (statuses/webhooks), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can order personalized physical cards through the API — custom card art, bulk orders, shipping methods and tracking — without managing a card manufacturer relationship myself
